description_en: Updates an approval process under the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 更新当前阿里云账号下审批流程
name: UpdateApprovalProcess

parameters.example: 终端软件安装审批流程
parameters.help_en: The name of the approval process. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 审批流程名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: process_name

parameters.example: 办公终端软件安装与卸载审批流程
parameters.help_en: The description of the approval process. The description must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), and spaces
parameters.help_zh: 审批流程描述。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和空格
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The list of approval nodes. You can define up to 5 approval nodes
parameters.help_zh: 审批节点列表。最多可定义5个审批节点
parameters.name: process_nodes

parameters.help_en: The external approval template configurations. Configure the approval template ID, external approval process ID, and field mappings based on the policy type. This parameter is used only when ApprovalType is set to 1 (DingTalk approval), 2 (WeCom approval), or 3 (Lark approval). If this parameter is not passed, the existing template associations of the approval process are cleared. However, the associations of approval templates that are already associated with business policies cannot be cleared
parameters.help_zh: 外部审批模板配置。按策略类型配置审批模板ID、外部审批流程ID和字段映射，仅 ApprovalType 为 1（钉钉审批）、2（企业微信审批）或 3（飞书审批）时使用。不传该字段时会清空审批流程已有的模板关联；已关联业务策略的审批模板不能清空
parameters.name: match_schema_configs

parameters.help_en: The approval type. Valid values: 0 (built-in approval), 1 (DingTalk approval), 2 (WeCom approval), and 3 (Lark approval). Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 审批类型。取值：0（内置审批）、1（钉钉审批）、2（企业微信审批）、3（飞书审批）。未传入时默认为 0（内置审批）
parameters.name: approval_type

parameters.help_en: The event callback identifier. When the approval type is 1 (DingTalk approval) or 3 (Lark approval), this parameter is used to generate the event callback URL for the external platform. You can specify a complete callback URL, and the server retains only the part after the callback path prefix
parameters.help_zh: 事件回调标识。审批类型为 1（钉钉审批）或 3（飞书审批）时，用于生成外部平台的事件回调地址；可传入完整回调地址，服务端仅保留回调路径前缀之后的部分
parameters.name: event_label

parameters.help_en: The integration configuration for the external approval platform. This parameter is required when the approval type is 1 (DingTalk approval) or 3 (Lark approval). It includes integration parameters such as appKey and appSecret, and must be passed as a JSON string
parameters.help_zh: 外部审批平台对接配置。审批类型为 1（钉钉审批）或 3（飞书审批）时必填，包含 appKey、appSecret 等对接参数，以 JSON 字符串传入
parameters.name: external_config
